title: 第656章 兰厉斩断川第655章 大族老救命
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
屈屠在格挡的间隙中下意识地扫了一眼战场。
之前那所谓的四凶都在，整个战场，唯独秦皓不在。
一股寒意从脊椎骨蹿上来，那个他最想杀的人，也是全场最不能放任不管的人，从他眼皮底下消失了。
“黑冲！”
秦邬童的身影骤然出现在他身侧，穷奇火翼拖出的青紫色尾焰还在空中燃烧。
屈屠瞳孔骤缩，来不及格挡，秦邬童的拳头已经砸在他腰肋上。
霸威之道裹着业火灌入体内，屈屠闷哼一声，胸口气血翻涌，一口灼热的淤血涌上喉头，被他死死压在舌根下。
“老头！你看你又心不在焉，是不是年纪大了？！”
秦邬童挠了挠头：“你再这样的话，小心被我打死了。”
屈屠听见这话，差点一口鲜再次喷出去，他娘的，自己还被这小子威胁上了？
不过...这黑塔小子说的没错，自己如果再中几招的话，很可能还真栽在这小子身上了。
而百丈外，兰厉与断川尊主的战斗已近白热化。
两人周围的地面像是被肆意撕扯了一般，量天尺的金色剑芒与焚宇犀皇的赤焰拳劲纵横交错，每一道余波落在焦土上都是一个大坑。
断川尊主的右臂被量天尺的剑芒削去了一块皮肉，焦黑的伤口边缘还在往外渗血，兰厉的青衫碎了大半，露出下面数道深可见骨的灼痕，量天尺融成的金色光膜在伤口处反复明灭，修补的速度赶不上新伤的速度。
“兰厉！”
断川尊主嘶吼着又轰出一拳，火焰拳劲在半空中拉出一道炽白的轨迹。
“你灭不了焚宇部！就算没了老祖，你今日也要死在这里！”
兰厉冷声道：“当初下令的就是你吧，正是因为你的决定，我妻子才会死，我的兄弟才会死。”
兰厉长长吐出一口气，手中量天尺化成的细长剑微微转动，周围空间再次震动了一下。
“今日，不是你死就是我亡！”

而就在此时，被屈屠信心心念念的秦皓出现在战场后方，背后赤焰焚天翼猛然展开，将他的身形托起，稳稳落在兰厉身后。
“兰族长，需要帮忙吗？”
兰厉瞥了眼他，随后又简单扫视了一眼下方的战况，山海部的局势着实让他一惊。
“需要，你来杀了他吧。”
秦皓挥着的手僵在半空中，干笑两声，“那个...我就那么一说。不过，你再怎么也是君初的父亲，晚辈不才，还是能助一臂之力的。”
他收敛了玩笑的神色，伸手朝兰厉肩头一拍，一道无形的斩空之力顺着他的掌心涌入兰厉体内，银白色的光芒在兰厉经脉中一闪而没。
“此物为先天图腾【斩空绝影】，助兰族长杀敌！”
对面的断川尊主死死盯着秦皓背后的赤焰焚天翼，眼角抽得几乎要痉挛。
他当然认得这对翅膀。
这对翅膀是他焚宇部先祖的极品纹器，是后山禁地里最重要的陪葬品之一。
这挨千刀的小贼，不光偷了石棺，还把祖宗的东西当着祖宗的面用！
“秦皓！”
断川尊主的声音像是从牙缝里硬挤出来的，“那是我焚宇部先祖的遗物！你竟，竟敢盗我先祖遗物！我定将你挫骨扬灰！”
秦皓眨了眨眼，低头看了看自己背后的翅膀，又抬头看了看断川尊主，脸上露出一种被冤枉了的无辜表情。
“断川尊主，话不能这么说。这对翅膀是晚辈从一尊石棺里找到的，你怎么能说是你们焚宇部的呢？”
断川尊主听不下去了，他怒吼着，周身气血轰然爆发，焚宇犀皇的虚影在身后凝聚到前所未有的凝实程度。
独角上的火焰从炽白烧成了幽蓝，幽蓝色的火焰中隐约有法则碎片在崩裂。
content_en:
Qu Tu subconsciously glanced at the battlefield between blocks.
The so-called four evil men before were all present, but Qin Hao was not in the entire battlefield.
A chill shot up from his spine. The person he wanted to kill the most, and the person in the room who could not be left alone, disappeared from under his eyes.
"Hei Chong!"
Qin Wutong's figure suddenly appeared beside him, and the purple tail flame dragged out by Qiongqi Fire Wings was still burning in the air.
Qu Tu's pupils shrank suddenly, and before he could block it, Qin Wutong's fist had already hit his waist and ribs.
The domineering way wrapped in the fire of karma poured into his body. Qu Tu groaned, blood surged in his chest, and a mouthful of hot congestion surged into his throat, which was firmly pressed under his tongue.
"Old man! Look, you're absent-minded again. Are you getting older?!"
Qin Wutong scratched his head: "If you do this again, I'll beat you to death."
When Qu Tu heard this, he almost spat out a mouthful of juice again. Damn it, was he threatened by this kid?
But... this Black Tower boy is right. If he gets hit by a few more moves, he might really fall into this guy's body.
But a hundred feet away, the battle between Lan Li and Lord Duanchuan was already heating up.
The ground around the two people seemed to be torn apart wantonly. The golden sword light of the Sky Measurement Ruler and the red flame fist power of Fenyu Rhinoceros crisscrossed each other. Every aftermath was a big crater on the scorched earth.
Lord Duanchuan's right arm was stripped of a piece of flesh by the sword light of the Sky-Measuring Ruler, and blood was still oozing out from the edge of the burnt wound. Most of Lan Li's green shirt was broken into pieces, revealing several deep burn marks on the bone underneath. The golden light film formed by the Sky-Measuring Ruler repeatedly flickered on and off at the wound, and the speed of repair could not keep up with the speed of new injuries.
"Lan Li!"
Lord Duanchuan roared and punched again, the flaming fist pulling out a blazing white trajectory in mid-air.
"You can't destroy the Fenyu tribe! Even if the ancestor is gone, you will die here today!"
Lan Li said coldly: "You must have been the one who gave the order in the first place. It was precisely because of your decision that my wife died and my brother died."
Lan Li let out a long breath, and the slender sword turned into a sky measuring ruler in his hand turned slightly, and the surrounding space shook again.
"Today, either you die or I die!"
At this moment, Qin Hao, whom Qu Tuxin had longed for, appeared at the rear of the battlefield. The Red Flame Burning Sky Wings behind him suddenly spread out, lifting his body up and landing firmly behind Lan Li.
"Clan Chief Lan, do you need help?"
Lan Li glanced at him, and then briefly glanced at the battle situation below. The situation in the Shanhai Department really shocked him.
"If necessary, come and kill him."
Qin Hao's waving hand froze in mid-air, and he laughed dryly, "Well...that's all I said. However, you are Jun Chu's father no matter what. If you are not talented as a junior, you can still help."
He stopped his joking expression and reached out to slap Lan Li on the shoulder. An invisible power of cutting the air flowed into Lan Li's body along the palm of his hand, and the silver-white light flashed in Lan Li's meridians.
"This object is the innate totem [Zhankong Jueying], which helps Chief Lan kill the enemy!"
Lord Duanchuan opposite Qin Hao stared at the red flame Fen Tianyi behind Qin Hao, his eyes almost twitching.
Of course he recognized the wings.
These wings are the top-grade ornaments of his ancestors from the Fenyu tribe, and they are one of the most important burial objects in the forbidden area of ​​​​the back mountain.
This little thief who had been stabbed a thousand times not only stole the sarcophagus, but also used his ancestor's belongings in front of his ancestor!
"Qin Hao!"
Lord Duanchuan's voice seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth, "Those are the relics of my ancestors of the Fenyu tribe! How dare you steal my ancestors' relics! I will crush your bones to ashes!"
Qin Hao blinked, looked down at the wings behind him, then looked up at Lord Duanchuan, with an innocent expression on his face.
"Lord Duanchuan, you can't say that. This junior found these wings from a sarcophagus. How can you say they belong to your Fenyu tribe?? "
Lord Duanchuan couldn't listen anymore. He roared angrily, and the energy and blood all over his body exploded. The shadow of Fenyu Rhinoceros Emperor condensed behind him to an unprecedented degree of solidity.
The flame on the horn turned from blazing white to faint blue, and there were faint fragments of law cracking in the blue flame.
